t: WDSV - Wikipedia
s: December 23, 2024 - WDSV (91.9 FM) is a radio station licensed to serve the community of Greenville, Mississippi. The station is owned by Delta Foundation, Inc., and airs a community radio format. The station was assigned the WDSV call letters by the Federal Communications Commission on December 22, 2008.
